name: Overstocked Fridge
text: At each shop, you may buy a second sigil.
archetypes: All; most for Gold Miner, Diamond Flood, Swap Meet
decision: Whether to spend a round's gold on two sigils or bank it for interest and a pricier offer.
aiNote: Buy a second sigil when it scores at least 10 a round and gold stays above 50 afterward.
rationale: Gold, not the rule, limits it: two sigils cost about 90 to 160 against about 65 income, so a double purchase comes every two or three shops, filling the 13-sigil collection faster; it fades once the collection is full, when selling (GY-U02) takes over.
